premises: Local atomic disorder (mass, size, electronegativity differences) causes force-constant fluctuations that enhance phonon scattering.
These force-constant fluctuations can be quantified from binary alloy trends and used as ML descriptors.
ML models using such descriptors will predict lower lattice thermal conductivity than mixture-rule models.
The predicted reduction will be ~20–30% for single-phase HEAs.
The approach is valid only for single-phase, entropy-stabilized HEAs without secondary phases or extrinsic defects.
